To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose a method for resynthesis to reduce the number path delay faults in a combinational logic circuit by replacing its subcircuits by structures called comparison unit and that the method is very effective.

the path delay fault (PDF) testability of a given combinational logic circuit can be improved without changing the number of gates or the number of long paths by replacing some of its gates with comparison units.

the resynthesis of combinational circuits to improve the path testability can be done effectively by replacing subcircuits with comparison units, that comparison units are fully test able for both stuck-at and path delay faults, that comparison units have a very small number of paths, and that comparison units have the same number of gates as the subcircuits that they replace.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of improving the path delay fault testing of combinational logic.
the problem of improving the path delay fault coverage of a combinational logic circuit by resynthesis using comparison units.
the following questions: (i) What is the class of functions that can be implemented by comparison units?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the resynthesis method proposed here improves the path delay fault (PDF) testability of a combinational logic circuit by reducing the number of paths, without increasing the number or the length of the longest path in a circuit.
the proposed method can significantly improve the path delay testability of a given circuit, and this can be done at no extra cost in terms of area and delay.
the method presented in the paper is effective in reducing the number of paths, and increasing the path delay fault coverage of combinational logic.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed a method to resynthesize combinational logic circuits to improve their path delay fault testabilities.

resynthesis of combinational circuits using comparison units can significantly improve path delay fault test coverage, without increasing the number or length of the paths in the circuits, and without increasing the size of the circuits.

we have developed a method for resynthesis that reduces the number of paths, increases the path delay fault coverage, and improves the path delay fault diagnosis capability of combinational logic circuit without increasing the number or complexity of the gates.
The main takeaway from our work is that
comparison functions are useful building blocks for improving path delay fault testabilities.
the proposed method is a promising technique for improving the path delay fault coverage of combinational logic circuit.
the use of comparison units in resynthesis can improve path delay fault test generation and test compaction.
